title: Exotic Crunchy Croatian Salmon Tagine
description: A winey and crunchy Croatian dish featuring salmon cooked in a tagine, perfect for a cozy dinner. This nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to delight your taste buds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the salmon fillets with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Place the salmon fillets in the tagine and spoon some of the sauce over them.
Cover the tagine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through.
While the salmon is baking, mix the crushed crackers with a little bit of olive oil and sprinkle over the top of the salmon.
Return the tagine to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes or until the top is crunchy.
